_about: Topics tools/refresh_osirdraft.mjs drafts OSIR analyst sections for, each at most every 20 hours, never-drafted and oldest first (.github/workflows/refresh-ai.yml, 3-hourly, on the runner's own open model). topics: cc (country), scope (a data set or conflict tab id as the OSIR window's Topic list uses it; empty = all reporting), days (the period, ending today), name. countries: all reporting for each of these (the original 28 countries). conflicts: true adds all reporting for the first country of every conflict tab in data/live/conflicts/index.js (a conflict tab is its own Topic only once it has taken over layers, like Deep South: list those under topics). Any other topic can be drafted on demand from osir-draft.yml's Run button.
